verdict: HPE posted record revenue of $12.2 billion, up 34%, as AI servers and a surging networking business drove record operating profit — helped by a $444 million one-time gain on selling an equity stake.

segments.name: Cloud & AI
segments.note: Servers ($6,766M), storage ($1,291M), financial services ($883M) and other ($102M) — AI server demand drove server revenue up 35%.

segments.name: Networking
segments.note: Campus and branch ($1,442M), routing ($788M), data-center networking ($382M) and security ($281M) — the Juniper acquisition supercharged this business.

segments.name: Corporate Investments & Other
segments.note: Smaller ventures and corporate items outside the two main businesses.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building servers, networking and AI systems.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Sales teams, marketing and running the company.

opex.name: Amortization of intangible assets
opex.note: Writing down the value of brands, technology and customer relationships bought in acquisitions, including Juniper.

otherDetail: A $444M gain on selling an equity interest, less $75M of interest and other costs — net $369M.
footerNote: Net earnings of $1,540M are attributable to HPE; after $29M of preferred-stock dividends, $1,511M was attributable to common stockholders.

takeaways.title: Networking exploded
takeaways.text: Networking revenue rose 75% to $2.9 billion — routing revenue alone rose 270% — as the Juniper Networks business (acquired in 2025) filled out HPE's AI data-center offer.

takeaways.title: AI servers are the engine
takeaways.text: Server revenue rose 35% to $6.8 billion on AI demand, gross margin expanded almost 11 points to 40.1%, and management raised the outlook for both fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2027.

takeaways.title: A one-time gain flattered profit
takeaways.text: A $444 million gain on selling an equity interest sits below operating profit — without it, pre-tax profit would have been about a quarter lower. The operating improvement is real, but not quite as big as the headline net income suggests.

oneTimers: A $444M gain on the sale of an equity interest is included in pre-tax earnings this quarter.
Operating expenses include $315M of acquisition-related intangible amortization and $71M of acquisition, disposition and other charges, largely tied to the Juniper acquisition.
